Part-A (10 x I= 10 Marks)

Define well-formed formula.

What is Tautology?

Discuss inclusion and Equality of sets.

Explain about storage structures.

Define Lattice with an example.

Find LUB and GLB for the subset {{a,b},{a},{b}} of power set of
A. where A={a,b,c}.

Use the multinomial theorem to expand (x,+x7+x3+X4)’.
Explain permutation and combination with an example.

Is there a simple graph with degree sequence (1,1,3,3,3,4,6,7)?
Define spanning tree with example.

Part-B (5 x 1 0= 50 Marks)

Show that SVR is tautologically implied by (PVQ)A(P—R)A(Q—S).
Obtain PDNF of the formula (1PV 1Q)—(P< 1Q).

OR
Construct the truth table of the formula (P?Q)((PAQ)V(TPA 1R)).
What is predicate, free and bound variables and quantifiers?

Let f: R-R and g: R-R, where R is the set of real numbers. Find
fog and gof where tix -2 and g(x)=x+4.State whether these
functions are bijective.
Let X={ball, bed, dog, let, egg}, and R is a relation defined on X as
R={(x,y)| xRy if x and y contain some common letter},Show that R
is compatibility relation and also find maximum compatibility blocks
for R.

OR
Let X={1,2,3,4} and R={(1,1),(1,4),(4,1),(4,4),(2,2),(2,3),(3,2),(3,3)}
check whether the relation is an equivalence relation, Write the
matrix of R and sketch its graph.
Let A ={a,b,c} be a finite set and p(A) its power set. Let © be the
inclusion relation on the elements of p(A).Draw Hasse diagram of
(p(A), S
Explain about the following.
i) Semi group ii) Sub monoid iii) Homomorphism.
Let S=NxN Let * be the operation on S defined by (a, b) * (c, d) =
(ac, bd).show that S is a semigroup under *.

OR
The set A={2,4,5,6,8,9} on which the operation * is defined by
a*b=Minimum of b. Find whether the given set forms a semi group
or monoid.
In a lattice (L,<,A,V)state and prove the laws idempotent,
commutative, associative and absorption.
